_primary_metric_hint: The one number THIS workflow optimises — commonly replies, meetings booked. A channel can still override it in shared/channels.json.
_published_dir_hint: Where this workflow's shipped artifacts go. Empty = the default, <workspace>/published/<this-workflow>/. Accepts a workspace-relative path or an absolute one (an external drive, a synced folder, a shared team drive). Set to "none" to skip the copy and leave artifacts in runs/<run_id>/output/.
_comment: This folder is fully self-contained: its own experiments, sources, templates, inputs, runs and reports. Want a second outreach workflow with a different goal or audience? Copy this whole folder to a new name (e.g. outreach-partners/), rewrite this file's goal and metric, and run it independently. The folder name is the workflow name; 'type' maps it to the engine-outreach skill.
